question: What is the id, line 1, and line 2 of the address with the most students?
reference_sql: SELECT T1.address_id ,  T1.line_1 ,  T1.line_2 FROM Addresses AS T1 JOIN Students AS T2 ON T1.address_id  =  T2.current_address_id GROUP BY T1.address_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

final.sql:
SELECT a.address_id, a.line_1, a.line_2
FROM Addresses a
JOIN (
    SELECT address_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS cnt
    FROM (
        SELECT current_address_id AS address_id, student_id FROM Students
        UNION ALL
        SELECT permanent_address_id AS address_id, student_id FROM Students
    )
    GROUP BY address_id
) s ON a.address_id = s.address_id
ORDER BY s.cnt DESC
LIMIT 1
